_comment: Coverage-gate-v2 floor (verbara-meta/ADR-0013). Manual ratchet, no CI write-back (ADR-0003/ADR-0038 D2). Two-sided band on line: fail if measured < line OR measured > line + slack (stale floor -> raise 'line' to floor(measured) in the same PR). 'branch' and 'lines_valid_min' are hard lower bounds; 'patch' is the diff-coverage floor (check-patch-coverage.py). Values honest as of the 2026-10-01 run (same unit subset as build-and-test, coverlet.runsettings): line 78.39%, branch 64.43%, lines-valid 30381. The account-status enforcement and its tests took line from 77.76% on the parent commit across the old 78% band ceiling, so 'line' was raised 75 -> 78 (floor(measured)); band now [78, 81]. Local measurement sits only 0.39 points above 'line': if CI measures under 78, add tests for the new paths rather than lowering the floor. 2026-10-11 (partner-channel-pilot-fixes): measured line 81.16%, branch 69.05%, lines-valid 34112 on the same subset, above the 81% band ceiling, so 'line' was raised 78 -> 81 (floor(measured)); band now [81, 84]. Local measurement sits 0.16 points above 'line'. 2026-10-27 (fix-ip-host-tenant-resolution): local run measured line 84.01% (above the 84% ceiling) but CI measured 83.94% on the same commit (branch 72.23%, lines-valid 39682), so 'line' was raised 81 -> 83 = floor(CI measurement), not 84; band now [83, 86] and both measurements sit inside it. Lesson: local and CI coverage drift by ~0.07 points here — take floor() of the CI number, never of a local one that lands within 0.1 of an integer.
